name: fiada
description: Codebase cartography: one map from repositories down to symbols.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n indexer,web -c yellow,cyan "bun run --cwd indexer dev" "bun run --cwd web dev"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared && tsc -p indexer && tsc -p web && tsc -p agent
scripts.test: bun run --cwd indexer test && bun run --cwd web test && bun run --cwd agent test
